--------
VladTV sits down with Finnish entrepreneur and high-stakes poker player Ossi Ketola, aka Monarch, for an unfiltered look at his rise from small-town Finland to the center of online gaming, crypto casinos and million-dollar poker duels. Ketola explains how RuneScape’s Duel Arena introduced him to digital economies as a teen, how Big Boy Bets collapsed after a partner dispute, and how Counter-Strike: Global Offensive skins led to a major gambling business amid Valve crackdowns and offshore regulation in Curaçao.

He also breaks down the launch of Duel, its zero-house-edge model, $2 billion monthly volume claims, and competition with crypto casino giant Stake. The conversation covers Bitcoin crashes, taxes, Tesla investments, Dubai, Finnish politics, Drake-style gambling promos, Triton Poker, Jungleman, and Ketola’s reported billionaire status.

In this VladTV interview, Charleston White breaks down the legal issues surrounding his recent warrant, bond conditions, and arrests in Texas, including a marijuana vape pen case and a separate Collin County incident involving medical marijuana and a gun. He also discusses a Broward County misdemeanor case he says remains unresolved.

The conversation turns to his fallout with Say Cheese TV’s Shawn Cotton after a post about his warrant allegedly included his actual home address. Charleston explains why he felt the post put his family at risk and why it changed his view of their business relationship. Vlad offers perspective on media platforms, viral arrest posts, and the tension between news coverage and personal relationships.

Charleston also mentions Rick Ross, HoneyKomb Brazy, O Zino, Dollface, Dewberry, Boosie, 1090 Jake, Charlie Kirk, brand deals, and the challenges of moving beyond online beef.

In this VladTV interview, Lil Jungle Boy details his early life around Los Angeles street politics, explaining his Blood affiliation near Baldwin Hills, Crenshaw Mall and the Inglewood area. He discusses family ties to T. Rodgers, growing up around the Jungle, and how the filming of *Training Day* brought new attention to the neighborhood.

The conversation then moves through Louisiana, Chicago and LA as Lil Jungle Boy recounts violent incidents from his childhood, including a shootout shortly before turning 9 after an alleged robbery attempt, and a stabbing involving an older man in Chicago. He describes being taught weapons knowledge at a young age and explains the circumstances behind those moments, while Vlad presses him on how a child could face grown men in those situations.

A raw discussion on upbringing, gangs, survival, and consequences in some of America’s most notorious neighborhoods.

Anthony Scaramucci sits down with VladTV for a wide-ranging conversation on his rise from a working-class Long Island family to Harvard Law, Goldman Sachs, Oscar Capital, and founding SkyBridge Capital. He breaks down making his first millions on Wall Street, selling to Neuberger Berman, the Lehman Brothers windfall, and how stocks, private equity, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana shaped his fortune.

Scaramucci also revisits his 11-day run as White House communications director under Donald Trump, the infamous Ryan Lizza interview, Reince Priebus, Steve Bannon, John Kelly, Russian sanctions, and why he later became a vocal MAGA critic while backing Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. The interview covers divorce, prenups, wealth, FTX Ventures’ $45 million SkyBridge investment, Sam Bankman-Fried’s fraud conviction, crypto scams, meme coins, Warren Buffett, Larry Fink, Jamie Dimon, and Scaramucci’s book *All the Wrong Moves*.

--------
TK Kirkland sits down with VladTV to discuss the latest reports surrounding Sean “Diddy” Combs’ prison transfer from Fort Dix following alleged issues behind bars. Vlad breaks down TMZ’s reporting about a possible fight, inmate phones, lockdown rumors, and claims that Diddy received special treatment, while TK shares what he heard from someone familiar with the facility. Kirkland argues that as the biggest celebrity in custody, Diddy must stay off the radar, avoid unnecessary attention—including inmate massages—and move quietly in his new, reportedly calmer facility.

The conversation expands into fame, public perception, and whether Diddy will be embraced or shunned after prison, with TK comparing the reaction to O.J. Simpson’s post-release celebrity encounters. Vlad also weighs in on social media clout, fan photos, and why public figures remain powerful even amid controversy. Kirkland closes with a blunt motivational take on commitment and identity.

G. Dep sits down with VladTV to discuss his next chapters in music and publishing, including a forthcoming book written by Ron Borges, known for the Christy Martin story, and released through Folio Publishing with Dan Pearson. The Harlem rapper also breaks down his new album *Off the Count*, a 17-track project tracing his incarceration journey from sentencing to Elmira Correctional Facility and eventually coming home.

Dep reflects on recording *Influential* entirely over the phone while locked up, then following it with *Lessons Never Losses* and *Stay Ready*. He also teases *Fish and Spaghetti*, planned around the 25th anniversary of his Bad Boy debut *Child of the Ghetto* on November 20. Plus, he previews upcoming collaborations tied to the Bad Boy era, including music with Black Rob on DNA Records and appearances from familiar names.
